summary: R5b (serial merge lane) self-review: 7/7 items pass.

items.note: All AC bullets from R5b-merge-lane.md covered — HEAD==reviewed_head assert+invalidate cascade, shipped_head read from review_pin.json directly, bounded mergeCommit.oid confirmation via mark-merged, currency check in reviewed with rebase cascade (max_rebase_reviews=2), STRICT-STOP drain (campaign_drain.py), step 3h status-vocabulary mapping. Verified via 18 new prose guards in test_campaign_r5b_merge_lane_prose.py, all passing.

campaign_drain.py: LockTimeout re-raised as TimeoutError with context; ValueError on wrong loop kind. check_review_attribution.py invalidate(): control-character rejection in --reason, legal no-op when no pin exists (supports repeated rebase-cascade re-entry).

merge-commit SHA validated via the existing 40-hex regex guard (lib.loop_state.is_valid_sha / audit_compliance_lifecycle.py::_merge_sha shape) before any git command sees it, reused not reinvented. review_attribution.py's own _SHA_RE (pre-existing) gates shipped_head. No hardcoded secrets. Bash snippets quote all variable expansions.

Real git integration tests via the git_origin_repo fixture (not mocked) for the staleness-cascade negative/positive pair; campaign_drain.py has 15 in-process unit tests (sweep/drain_once/remaining_active/run_drain with injectable sleep_fn/time_fn, no real sleeping).

Drain poll interval is a bounded 5s default, injectable; no N+1 — state is a single JSON file read/written per pass under one file-lock acquisition per sweep+poll iteration, matching R4's own established pattern.

campaign_drain.py mirrors loop_mark.py's cmd_*/main() dispatch shape; reason codes follow the existing snake_case convention (swept_never_started, drain_timeout, lease_expired_during_drain, merge_confirmation_timeout, staleness_cascade_exhausted).

ADR-024: two producer/consumer boundaries changed. (1) review_pin.json: producer lib.review_attribution.pin()/ship(), consumer campaign-mode.md 3g's .pin.shipped_head read — round-trip probed via test_check_review_attribution_invalidate.py's real-git fixture (pin write -> verify read -> invalidate -> re-verify absent). (2) loop_state.json units[].status during drain: producer campaign_drain.py, consumer lib.loop_state.sub_iterate_finalize_summary (cmd_finalize) and campaign-mode.md step 3h's status-vocabulary mapping — round-trip probed via test_campaign_drain.py's run_drain scenario asserting the state file left on disk is finalize-ready (nothing outside TERMINAL).
